**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Mrs Donkin](../persons.html#441),
As soon as may be I will get the Summer Vacation sent to the press, but it cannot be before October at soonest that I send it - as all these remarkable events have thrown other M S back. I have a Naval Review just come, to complete the series you began.

By the by, it was a Woolwich cadet’s uniform that [prince Arthur](../persons.html#1997) wore - as the [daughter](../persons.html#1520) of the late [commandant](../persons.html#1521) specially begged me to observe. I wonder whether the Prince will criticise it too.
I was not sure enough where you were to send you the proofs, as there was no time to spend in their wanderings

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Unidentified.

[^3]: ‘The naval review’, by A sailor’s daughter, had appeared in MP in September.
